scene_end_anchor: Sitting motionless to avoid fatal stamina drain, Rhea watched a scavenger mob interact with the environment. She observed the creature knock a branch loose from a tree without triggering a System Gathering Tax. Realizing the physics engine operated outside the System's economy ledger, she deduced a loophole. Rhea formulated a plan to exploit the physics engine, preparing to herd the mob into a deadfall trap.
